data.confidence_threshold: Confidence needed to act without the LLM
data.llm_hass_api: Home Assistant control for the LLM

data_description.decision_model: Judges every request first. Jev answers in a fraction of a second.
data_description.confidence_threshold: Below this confidence the request goes to the LLM instead. Unlocking and opening always need at least 0.9.
data_description.chat_model: Handles conversation, questions and anything the decision model is not sure about. Must support tool calling.
data_description.web_search: The LLM looks up current information on its own when an answer needs it. OpenRouter runs the search and each one costs about a cent on top of the model price.
data_description.tts_voice: Voices depend on the text-to-speech model. Save and reopen the options after changing the model to see its voices.
